integrity: The proof reduces the odd condition to an exact comparison of row and column color sets. The balanced lower bound is counting-theoretic and the upper bounds are explicit. The checker independently evaluates properness and neighborhood parity from the graph-array definition.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to Cartesian products of two complete graphs and does not classify arbitrary line graphs or higher-dimensional Hamming graphs.
The finite verifier checks explicit constructions through the stated finite ranges and exhaustive balanced cases only through order four; the arbitrary-order theorem is analytic.
Originality is assessed against targeted literature and published-result searches and is not an absolute uniqueness guarantee.
title: Odd chromatic number of rook graphs
